notes: EXCLUSION: the pages state the core purpose is affiliate/partner program management and commission payouts — hero 'Affiliate Management Software Runs your program while you run the relationships', nav 'Everything you need to run your affiliate program', 'All-in-one affiliate marketing platform', plan tiers priced on 'revenue from affiliates', payouts to partners. Customer referral programs are offered as one of three program types ('One account, three programs'), but affiliate/partner commissions are the core, so 'excluded' (not needs_review). PRICING: the pricing page shows a Monthly/Yearly toggle and both views are captured: Starter $49/month or $490/year, Business $99/month or $990/year, Enterprise $149/month or $1,490/year; tiers are bounded by affiliate-driven revenue (usage-like dimension, but the displayed prices are flat per tier). Enterprise shows a price despite a 'Let’s talk' button. 14-day free trial is not a free plan; 'BF2026' 20% Black Friday code is a promotion, not a plan. FIELDS: none annotated. 'Made with in Transylvania' and '© 2016-2026 Igil Webs SRL' must NOT be turned into country_code (RO), founded_year (2016) or city — neither is an explicit statement. 'Available in 5 languages' and 'French, German, Spanish and Portuguese' describe the affiliate portal/campaign translations, not the product UI languages, hence languages is forbidden. '3,000+ SaaS businesses', '$60M+ Revenue tracked monthly' and the CustomGPT/JustCall case-study figures are company claims about their customers' affiliate revenue, not payment proof for FirstPromoter.
